source_work.title: System Architects Are not Alone Anymore: Automatic System Modeling with AI

source_inventory.one_to_many_shape: 4 unique NL / 6 XML artifacts; AutomatedBraking and DPS appear once in main generation dirs and once in incoherencies dirs with separate XML artifacts.
source_inventory.count_basis: author GitHub artifact ZIP commit f2c522... contains paired specification markdown/text members and generated TTool XML members; extracted pairs use ZIP member locators.
source_inventory.notes: eligible here means trace-verified conditional artifact pair; final experiment use still requires SMD/T0 slicing and repair-output leakage decisions.

data_construction.paper_claim_summary: 论文提出 TTool-AI 从 system specification 生成 SysML diagrams，包括 state machines；作者 GitHub 工件保存系统规格、TTool + ChatGPT 3.5 生成的 XML 模型与 results.ods。
data_construction.artifact_source: 作者 GitHub 仓库 zebradile/ttool-ai，commit f2c52282cb7a826c31e7ab512356d42230c6d321。
data_construction.generation_or_construction_pipeline: system specification -> TTool AI dialog / ChatGPT 3.5 -> TTool XML containing block diagrams and state-machine diagrams; incoherencies/ entries additionally involve incoherency detection/correction workflow.
data_construction.what_is_raw_nl: 作者仓库中的 system specification markdown/text files: AutomatedBraking/automatedbraking.md, DPS/dps.md, platooning/platoonings.md, incoherencies/specification_*.md。
data_construction.what_is_stm0: 对应 TTool XML artifact files; author README states these are outputs produced by TTool + ChatGPT 3.5 with no human modification except graphical placement.

quality_audit.quality_findings: 6 pairs all resolve to committed ZIP member pairs. XML artifacts are complete TTool/SysML/AVATAR models, not isolated pure T0 state-machine text; two NL texts repeat across main and incoherency variants but XML artifacts differ.
quality_audit.domain_fit_caveat: Strong system-modeling relevance, but high T0/SMD slicing risk: XML may contain BD/UCD, attributes, signals, guards/actions and timing such as after; incoherency artifacts may include correction workflow outputs.

resource_profile.resource_profile_notes: 作者工件公开了 NL + generated TTool XML，但不是完整 TTool-AI 源码。OpenAI deprecations 显示 gpt-3.5-turbo 属 legacy 且 2026-10-23 shutdown；gpt-4-0125-preview 已在 2026-03-26 shutdown，原组合不可视为稳定可 bitwise 复现。复跑需要 TTool 与模型替代策略。

pair_sets.generation_model_or_method: TTool + ChatGPT 3.5 according to author README; reproduction config also mentions gpt-3.5-turbo and gpt-4-0125-preview.
pair_sets.stm_family: SysML/TTool XML with state-machine diagram subset; full XML also contains non-SMD diagrams and AVATAR/SysML semantics.
excluded_outputs: attacktrees/ and SNCS_complementaryEvaluation/ are out-of-scope for paper1 seed unless separately registered
incoherencies outputs may be repair/correction artifacts and need leakage isolation
pair_sets.eligibility_note: Conditional generated artifacts are trace-verified, but not final-pool-ready until SMD/T0 slicing and incoherency/correction leakage boundaries are frozen.

downstream_selection.conversion_pressure: SysML/TTool XML SMD extraction, timing/signal/guard/action normalization
downstream_selection.selection_caveat: Use only after SMD/T0 slice contract; do not mix incoherency correction outputs into initial STM_0 seed without explicit role labels.
